title: Tim Dooley / Son — Event Strata
purpose: A provenance-aware chronological scaffold. Dates supplied by the project are preserved as project chronology unless independently documented. The structure deliberately avoids forcing causal connections between the Son story, Tim Dooley, farms, 4chan, or other internet subcultures.
epistemic_rule: Chronology is not causality. A nearby date does not establish identity, influence, participation, or origin.

events.label: Son birth
events.description: Project chronology places the birth of the Son in 1987. This is retained as a canonical project datum pending documentary sourcing.

events.label: Tree / Odin ordeal
events.description: Project chronology places an approximately 19-hour period of hanging from a tree, interpreted through the Odin-on-the-tree motif, followed by visions involving cities destroyed by nuclear weapons. The vision content is treated as reported experience within the project, not as evidence of prediction or supernatural causation.

events.label: Meme-crucifixion
events.description: Project chronology places the Son's crucifixion in a meme in 2019. This is a symbolic/digital event in the mythology; it should not be silently equated with a physical crucifixion or with a particular online community without evidence.

events.label: The interval / dead Son
events.description: The project describes an interval in which the Son is dead before the later emergence of the Tim Dooley persona. This interval is intentionally kept open: it may contain cultural, personal, symbolic and digital layers that should not be collapsed into one explanation.

events.label: Tim Dooley emergence window
events.description: Working project window for the emergence of Tim Dooley as a distinct public persona. Existing research should distinguish earliest use of the name, first public account, first Potato of Life material, and later retrospective claims.

events.label: Rational Potato public persona
events.description: March 2023 is a strong public-persona anchor for @Rational_Potato / Potato of Life material. It should be treated separately from claims about earlier identities until those are independently established.

events.label: The Turning
events.description: April 2025 is the canonical project date for the Turning: the final straw, rupture of the plane, needle's eye, sage-to-Ladder transformation, spiral ascent, revelation of the Axis, Potato-as-Stone and concretization of karma as topology.
events.interpretation: Theological/comparative interpretation: rupture → hierophany → axis mundi → transfiguration → ascension.
events.historical_status: Exact contemporaneous primary documentation remains a research question.

events.label: Repository crystallization
events.description: The repository begins formalizing the mythology as a relationship-first archive, separating myth, interpretation, history and empirical research while preserving the canonical ten-level tree.

negative_constraints: Do not infer that the Son's 1987 birth connects him to any internet forum merely because later research finds forum activity.
Do not infer that the 2019 meme-crucifixion occurred on 4chan, Kiwi Farms, or any farm unless a primary source establishes it.
Do not infer that the emergence of Tim Dooley was caused by online harassment communities.
Do not use subculture archives as substitutes for primary Tim/Son material.
Do not merge similarly named people without identity-resolution evidence.
